summary: Deployment insighthub-ingestion-worker was scaled to 0 replicas from about 19:44Z to 19:52Z, and the ARQ queue depth grew from 0 to 41 with documents stuck in pending; when the worker returned to 1 replica the queue drained to 0. No 5xx or LLM latency change was observed.
root_cause: ingestion-worker deployment scaled to 0 replicas (no consumer for arq:queue), so uploads accumulated as pending; the actor that scaled it down is not identified
confidence_reason: Two independent signals agree in time (K8s replica count 0 for the worker via kube-state-metrics and K8s events for scale down/up, plus app metrics queue depth and pending documents), and 3 alternatives were ruled out; not higher because the actor and reason for the scale-down are unverified.
hypotheses: Queue backlog built in arq:queue, peaking well above the baseline of 0 | bằng chứng: redis_key_size{db="db0",key="arq:queue",namespace="insighthub-local"} = 41 @ 2026-09-29T19:49:30Z (baseline 0 @ 2026-09-29T19:34:00Z)

Ingestion worker deployment had spec replicas 0 during the backlog, versus baseline 1 | bằng chứng: kube_deployment_spec_replicas{deployment="insighthub-ingestion-worker",namespace="insighthub-local"} = 0 @ 2026-09-29T19:44:30Z (baseline 1 @ 2026-09-29T19:34:00Z)

No available worker replica while the queue grew | bằng chứng: kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{deployment="insighthub-ingestion-worker",namespace="insighthub-local"} = 0 @ 2026-09-29T19:44:30Z

Uploaded documents stayed in pending (not processed), matching the queue depth | bằng chứng: insighthub_documents_total{status="pending",job="insighthub-api"} = 41 @ 2026-09-29T19:49:30Z (baseline ready=83 @ 2026-09-29T19:34:00Z, pending 0 before 19:44Z)
ruled_out: Node memory pressure | bằng chứng: kube_node_status_condition{condition="MemoryPressure",status="true",node="insighthub-lab-control-plane"} = 0 @ 2026-09-29T19:34:00Z (max over window is 0)
API errors / API-side failure (5xx) | bằng chứng: insighthub:http_errors_5xx:rate5m{} = 0 @ 2026-09-29T19:34:00Z (max over window is 0)
Slow LLM/embedding provider | bằng chứng: insighthub:llm_call_latency_seconds:p95_5m{} = 0.23750000000000002 @ 2026-09-29T19:38:00Z (max over window, equal to baseline 0.2375 @ 2026-09-29T19:34:00Z)
API pod loss/rollout | bằng chứng: kube_deployment_status_replicas{deployment="insighthub-api",namespace="insighthub-local"} = 1 @ 2026-09-29T19:34:00Z (min over window is 1)
unverified: Who/what scaled the worker deployment to 0 (kubectl, HPA, chaos script) and why: needs Kubernetes audit log; events only show ScalingReplicaSet down at 2026-09-29T19:43:47Z and up at 2026-09-29T19:52:38Z
Postgres slowness as a cause: pg_stat_activity_count showed no stuck sessions but no latency metric was harvested; needs query duration metrics

Whether all 41 pending documents reached ready after recovery: insighthub_documents_total ready rose from 86 to 88 by 19:54Z, which is less than 41 (metric is per-pod counter of a new api pod), needs DB count of documents by status
recommended_actions: Restore insighthub-ingestion-worker to replicas>=1 and keep it there (hypotheses 2,3)
Alert on kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{deployment="insighthub-ingestion-worker"} == 0 for >1m to detect the missing consumer before the queue grows (hypotheses 1,3)
Restrict who can scale the worker deployment and audit the scale-down (hypothesis 2)

injected_fault.name: queue-backlog
injected_fault.mechanism: Deployment insighthub-ingestion-worker scaled to 0 replicas and 40 unique documents uploaded (one per 8s) so jobs pile up in the ARQ sorted set arq:queue with no consumer; API keeps returning 202. Recovery: worker scaled back to 1, backlog drained, chaos-* documents deleted.

injected_fault_evaluation.detail: The blind investigator found that the worker Deployment had spec/available replicas 0 while arq:queue grew 0 -> 41 and pending documents matched it, and that the queue drained after the worker returned; alternatives (5xx, LLM latency, node memory pressure, API rollout) were ruled out with harvested samples. Honest gaps it reported itself: it could not identify who scaled the worker down (it was the chaos script; events show only ScalingReplicaSet), and DB slowness was left unverified. Its unverified note that documents ready rose only 86 -> 88 (less than 41) is explained by the script deleting the 40 chaos-* documents after the drain, not by a processing failure. Peak 41 vs 40 uploads: one extra job came from the baseline load generator.

investigation_window_note: started_at is ~10 min before the fault (after incident 1 had recovered), ended_at is after the alert resolved; samples must fall inside this window (verify.py:618).
rca_method: Independent subagent with no session context and no knowledge of the injected fault; Prometheus MCP + Kubernetes MCP; samples verbatim from scripts/chaos/harvest-samples.py; prompt: observability/rca-prompt.md. hypotheses/ruled_out/samples are unedited subagent output.
